scope: Authenticated in-process central API and disposable SQLite queue; a real read-only connection causes the receipt-save failure.
lease_expiry: Controlled in disposable storage; no real-time recovery measurement.
limitations: SQLITE_READONLY failure only; not actual disk exhaustion, hardware storage failure, power loss, remote transport or physical acceptance.
sanitization: Allowlisted counts/assertions/error code only; no identities, credentials, session tokens, record IDs, URLs, database files or local paths.
